movelist.name: Mirror Move
movelist.effect: Use the Move the target has used on their last turn. You may choose new targets for the Move. Mirror Move cannot miss.

movelist.name: Confide
movelist.effect: The target’s Special Attack is lowered 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Growl
movelist.effect: Growl lowers all Legal Targets Attack 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Sing
movelist.effect: All legal Targets fall Asleep. On a miss, Sing instead causes targets to become Slowed and suffer a -2 penalty to their Evasion until the end of the user’s next turn.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.effect: The user’s Accuracy cannot be lowered, their attacks cannot have Accuracy Penalties (such as from Illuminate), the user is immune to the Blind condition (but not Total Blindness), and the user ignores any Evasion not directly derived from Stats (such as from the Instinct Ability, or from moves like Minimize).

abilities.name: Tangled Feet
abilities.effect: While Confused or Slowed, the user gains +3 Evasion. The user is immune to the Vulnerable Condition.
